svg.title: Architecture 1: TabularResNet
svg.desc: Independent delivery steps · Fourier features · Three residual blocks · 8 training epochs

g.text: Independent delivery steps · Fourier features · Three residual blocks · 8 training epochs
• Nine raw origin features: latest spread, direction,
mFRR activation, and recent spread statistics
• ControlledScaler encodes numeric inputs with clip and asinh
Origin state is constant across the 40 delivery steps
Reuse the same origin state at each 15-minute step
Day-ahead spot (spot_level) and its one-hour change
Day-ahead wind forecast and net load
Load plan deviation and calendar features
Uses day-ahead covariates available at the forecast origin
Each row combines the origin state with its own covariates
• Each of the 40 steps is processed independently
• Same raw feature groups as the LightGBM model
Baseline for measuring the effect of cross-step modelling
Six learned frequencies per input channel
• Learn periodic transforms of continuous inputs
• Retain raw values alongside sine and cosine terms
Concatenate raw values, sine and cosine
• Add six sine terms per channel
• Add six cosine terms per channel
5. Identity skip connection: output = skip(x) + h → [B, 40, 128]
• SiLU is applied between the two linear layers
• Dropout follows the second linear layer
All three blocks keep the same width
• h goes to the hierarchical probability head
• raw_in also goes directly to the head
Ordered by construction: q_05 ≤ … ≤ q_50 ≤ … ≤ q_95
Quantile loss: 0.45 × grid pinball + 0.35 × MAE + 0.20 × tail pinball
Inference averages the classifier and quantile CDF estimates
Shapes: X_state [B,20] + X_step [B,40,30] → raw_in [B,40,50] → Fourier [B,40,650] → backbone [B,40,128] → quantiles [B,40,19] and two class heads [B,40,3]
